verdict.line: You lose extended trades once Sion's W shield and the permanent max HP he banks from E kills outscale you, but you win isolated fights and executions where your range and R land clean.

brief.thesis: Sion's W (Death's Caress) absorbs and punishes prolonged trading while E (Enrage) permanently stacks his max HP on every kill, letting him out-scale a standing fight. Urgot's longer reach and E (Disdain) interrupt flip that script in isolated skirmishes, which is why the data splits: lane edge to Sion, solo-kill edge to Urgot, netting 46.4% for Urgot over 84 games against a 52.3% baseline across 7,414 Urgot top games overall.

theirWindow.when: W shield up and E toggled on
theirWindow.what: Stop feeding autos into the shield and disengage — it absorbs damage then detonates in an AoE burst, so trading into it just arms his bomb.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Cryptic Gaze) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and poke freely with Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range) or land autos; without the 550-range stun ready he has no tool to lock you down before you kite away.

start.why: Sits at 52.2% over 90 games and 78.3% pick rate; the extra sustain and AD matter because Sion's melee range and Q stun threat punish you for standing still to farm.

boots.why: 49.5% pick rate at 38.9% win over 54 games; flat physical damage reduction directly answers Sion's auto-attacks and Q, which are both physical.

core.why: Armor shred rewards the repeated hits your W (Purge) and Echoing Flames passive already want to land, and it's the top-picked first item at 84.6% in its build path.
The damage amp and health shield matter directly against Sion's E (Enrage), which trades his own HP for AD and can swing all-ins fast.
Bonus health and scaling damage help you out-tank the permanent max HP Sion is banking every time his E lets him finish off a unit.

the enemy team shifts toward heavier magic damage later
you want faster wave clear to punish sion's slower farm pattern

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the rapid consecutive hits Purge (W) and your autos already deliver, and the extra damage on a marked target pays off hardest during the all-in windows you create after an E interrupt.

summoners.why: Run at 55.2% pick and 48.4% win; Ignite converts Urgot's measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills and offsets the sustain Sion gets from R (Cannibalism) and his growing HP pool.

playing.title: Poke before he closes
playing.detail: Use Q (Corrosive Charge, 800 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cooldown) to chip Sion and slow him before he's inside his own Q (Cryptic Gaze, 550 range) threat range.

playing.title: Save E for his Q
playing.detail: Charge E (Disdain, 475 range, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s cooldown) the instant Sion winds up Cryptic Gaze — catching him stops your dash and hurls him out of position, interrupting the cast entirely.

playing.title: Don't trade into his shield
playing.detail: Death's Caress (W, 8s cooldown, 100 range) absorbs your hits then explodes outward; stop attacking once it's up and wait it out instead of feeding it damage.

playing.title: Track his E stacks
playing.detail: Enrage (E) has no cooldown and permanently raises his max HP on every unit kill, so punish his free wave-clear windows at levels 3-5 before those stacks pile up.

playing.title: Sequence into Purge
playing.detail: W (Purge) prioritizes champions you've already struck and triggers Echoing Flames blasts, so land a Q or auto first, then unload once he's committed to the trade.

playing.title: Hunt isolated picks with R
playing.detail: Fear Beyond Death reaches 2500 range and executes low-health targets — since the data favors Urgot in solo kills, look to snipe Sion whenever he's split from his team.

playing.title: Respect his committed all-ins
playing.detail: Once his W shield and E toggle are both active and his R (Cannibalism) is up, he can trade hard and sustain through it — hold spacing until you've landed your own poke first.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, boots, runes, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning tying them to Sion's kit and timings is my own read.
